local_availability_status: NOT_LOCALLY_PRESENT (Reported per Phase 4 requirement; zero synthetic data invented)
official_source: Crowdsensing-based Road Damage Detection Challenge (CRDDC'2022), IEEE BigData 2022

license_compliance.attribution_requirement: Must cite: Arya et al., Global Road Damage Detection: State-of-the-art Solutions and Open Challenges, IEEE Trans. Intell. Transp. Syst., 2022.

D00.name: Longitudinal Crack
D00.visual_definition: Linear crack parallel to the road centerline along wheel tracks or paving joints.

D10.name: Transverse Crack
D10.visual_definition: Linear crack perpendicular to the road direction, commonly thermal or sub-base shrinkage.

D20.name: Alligator Cracking
D20.visual_definition: Network of interconnected polygonal cracks resembling reptile skin, indicating structural base failure.

D40.name: Potholes & Depressed Manholes
D40.visual_definition: Bowl-shaped cavity in asphalt surface exceeding 25mm depth and 150mm diameter.

proposed_split_isolation.isolation_rule: Video sequences partitioned strictly by vehicle session ID (India_xxxxxx series) to ensure no consecutive dashcam frames leak between train and validation/test.
